name: sol_basics_vi_ovi_9
description: Denial-of-service in OpenZeppelin ERC165Checker/ERC165CheckerUpgradeable due to unbounded staticcall return data
question: The source file in `source` imports or calls OpenZeppelin's ERC165Checker or ERC165CheckerUpgradeable library (versions >=2.3.0 and <4.7.2) to query supportsInterface/supportsERC165InterfaceUnchecked on an untrusted or user-supplied contract address without limiting gas or return-data size, allowing that contract to cause excessive resource consumption and a denial of service, and this does not apply if the library version used is patched (>=4.7.2 or <2.3.0) or if the target contract address is always trusted/fixed rather than attacker-controlled.
criteria: Imports OpenZeppelin's ERC165Checker.sol (version >=2.3.0 <4.7.2) and calls supportsInterface() on an arbitrary, caller-supplied contract address
Calls ERC165CheckerUpgradeable's supportsInterface() or getSupportedInterfaces() passing a user-provided contract address directly into the vulnerable library function
Directly calls the vulnerable supportsERC165InterfaceUnchecked() function on an untrusted external contract, forwarding a staticcall whose return data length is not capped
Loops over a list of interface IDs calling ERC165Checker functions against a user-controlled contract address, enabling a malicious contract to return oversized data and exhaust gas
